slot.brief: Compare curie and becquerel / relate activity in curies to decays per second, or convert between radioactivity units; one-step unit conversion.

stem: The activity of a sample is $2.5\times10^{-6}$ Ci. What is its activity in becquerels? Use $1$ Ci $=3.7\times10^{10}$ Bq.
working:
$A=(2.5\times10^{-6})(3.7\times10^{10})$ Bq\\
$A=9.25\times10^4$ Bq

Independent check: (2.5×10⁻⁶ Ci)(3.7×10¹⁰ Bq/Ci) = 9.25×10⁴ Bq.
